notes: 4.5.3 bounded the census fetch so its spinner could not hang for ever, and did it by reaching for scrFetch, because that helper already had a timeout. scrFetch posts to /scr/ — the screener router. The census is a /cm/ op. So the screener answered exactly as it should: > ⚠ unknown screener op A routing bug wearing the costume of a timeout feature, and it replaced an infinite spinner with an immediate error. Not an improvement. cmFetch now carries its own optional timeout — AbortController, cleared on both the response and network-failure paths — and the census uses it. No helper is borrowed ac
